text_block_list.text: Ow...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, me? I'm fine! I just hurt myself a
little...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Okay, back to training! Sorry for
worrying you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Though Мэдзиро Райан is cheerful as ever,
an injury
is still an injury.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: We should take a break, just to be safe.
Forget about the pain and stay focused!

text_block_list.text: Huh? B-but it's really not a big deal!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Look! See how easy I can do squats?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ryan attempts a squat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ack!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ah... You're right! Sorry...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
If this were a bad injury, I wouldn't be
able to
race...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(McQueen would've never let this
happen to
herself.)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm still not as aware of my body
as I need
to be.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
We agree to stick to rest and recovery
that day,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Focus... focus! At a time like this, I gotta
use my
abdominal muscles to breathe
from my
diaphragm!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My fears come true, and Ryan's injury
isn't healing
as fast as I'd hoped.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We finish training, but it looks like Ryan
will make
a full recovery by tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ngh, okay... Sorry...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
